products.title: Feral Design Service
products.body_html:
Tell us what you want and our design team builds it for you.

What you get

  • 4 designs to start, back with you in 24 to 48 hours.
  • One round of feedback. Tell us what to change and we send 4 more.
  • 8 designs in total.

The $20 comes off your ferrule order. Once you pick a design we send you a code for $20 off, good on any Feral order. So if you buy, the design costs you nothing.

No artwork skills needed. Send us a logo, a crest, a photo of the colors you mean, or just describe it.

products.title: Grab Bag – Random Mix
products.body_html:
A little mystery. A lot of swagger. Zero regrets.

The Grab Bag is for golfers who like surprises and unique Ferals for each clubs almost as much as they like flushing a 7-iron. Each pack includes a random assortment of custom Feral Golf Co. ferrules — pulled from past drops, prototypes, limited runs, color tests, and a few that were just too cool to keep on the shelf.

You pick the quantity. We pick the chaos.

What to expect:

  • A mix of colors, gradients, textures, and patterns

  • Designs you might never see again

  • Occasional unreleased or experimental pieces

  • Perfect for builders, tinkerers, or anyone who wants their bag looking less “stock” and more savage artisan

Whether you're refreshing old clubs, testing builds, or just want a hit of randomness to spice up your setup, the Grab Bag does the job. It’s the easiest way to add personality without overthinking it - and honestly, half the fun is not knowing what’s inside.

--

products.title: Feral Golf Standard Ferrule - Shorty Model
products.body_html:
Your Standard Shorty

Turn your imagination into performance with Your Standard Shorty, Feral Golf's ferrule option built from our Feral Designs collection. Pick your design in the Design Studio - no preset colors, no rules, no limits. Whether you're chasing clean minimalism, bold contrast, or something no one's ever seen before, your design becomes the statement.

Crafted to the same tour-grade tolerances as our signature lineup, each ferrule is built for a perfect flush fit - now with the look pulled straight from the Feral Designs lineup.

From subtle personal touches to full-blown creativity, Your Standard Shorty gives you the freedom to build a setup that's unmistakably yours. Golf gear, unleashed.

--

  • Design: Whatever you want it to be!

  • Material: Durable composite resin designed to resist cracking and fading

  • Fit: Compatible with both .355 taper tip and .370 parallel shafts

  • Finish: Textured matte finish with UV-protective coating
